verdict.rationale: The docs show programmatic control of headless browser sessions through an official SDK. They also describe full browser control with auto-waits, network interception and multi-tab support, which fits the scraping use case. However, none of the evidence names Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or Scrapy, so compatibility with these open-source libraries is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documented integration with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium and Scrapy; connection examples or quickstarts for each library; independent or hands-on corroboration of using these libraries with Browserbase.
